name: Homestead
description: Homestead is a self-hosted digital home for local movies, TV, music, books, archived YouTube, collections, watch orders, progress, and personal archives. This listing installs the free preview for one owner and one active stream.

paths.name: Recipes
paths.description: Persistent recipe metadata and photos. Reuse this folder after server reconfiguration. Existing installations must add this mapping and the Recipe metadata folder variable.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Persistent Homestead database, settings, indexes, and generated metadata. Back up this folder before updates.

paths.name: Movies
paths.description: Your Movies share. Change this path to match your server.

paths.name: TV Shows
paths.description: Your TV share. Change this path to match your server.

paths.name: Music
paths.description: Your Music share. Change this path to match your server.

paths.name: Books
paths.description: Your Books share. Change this path to match your server.

paths.name: Photos
paths.description: Your Photos share. Change this path to match your server.

paths.name: YouTube
paths.description: Your locally archived YouTube share. Change this path to match your server.

variables.name: Recipe metadata folder
variables.description: Container path for portable recipe metadata; must match the Recipes path mapping.

variables.name: Public origin
variables.description: Optional HTTPS public origin used only behind a correctly configured reverse proxy.

variables.name: Time zone
variables.description: IANA time zone used for dates and schedules.
